mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WORK_LOG (user_id, job_id, work_date, start_time, end_time, task_count, fatigue, estimated_income, status, settlement_status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{jobId}, #{workDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{taskCount}, #{fatigue}, #{estimatedIncome}, #{status}, #{settlementStatus})
mapper.update: UPDATE WORK_LOG SET job_id = #{jobId}, work_date = #{workDate}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, task_count = #{taskCount}, fatigue = #{fatigue}, estimated_income = #{estimatedIncome}, status = #{status}, settlement_status = #{settlementStatus} WHERE log_id = #{logId}
